next_action: Register the priority projects in the project stage after fixing the registration unit as the 18 policies of the Comprehensive Plan and confirming the published form of the policy evaluation sheets; register the governor's promises in the promise stage from the official 2026 election bulletin, which survives on the election commission's current pages; add the assembly layer in the assembly stage, where the FY2025 settlement bills (four bills) stand continued in committee and remain pending; keep supplementary budgets, execution and settlement as separate states.
quality_boundary: The prefecture's top-level plan is the Fukushima Prefecture Comprehensive Plan (福島県総合計画, adopted in October 2021, period FY2022-FY2030). This review fixes that identity, the three-field structure (18 policies, 76 measures, 255 initiatives), the basic indicators set per measure, the two implementation plans run as its twin wheels (ふくしま創生総合戦略 and 第2期福島県復興計画), and the progress governance based on the policy-level evaluation sheets (政策分野別主要施策評価調書). Fukushima Prefecture had no reviewed package in this repository before this stage, so this review rests on the prefecture's and the MIC's own published documents alone. The registration unit for the project stage is fixed as the policy (政策), the unit at which the prefecture itself publishes its official evaluation.
